Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.

Waabi’s autonomous-driving stack is powered by Waabi World, which delivers realistic, scalable, controllable, and efficient simulation. As a Research Engineer in the World Models team, you will develop algorithms and productionize the next generation of World Models that can reason about complex, dynamic 4D environments.
This role focuses on large-scale world models for temporal reasoning and generation, including video models, multimodal generative models, LLM/VLM/VLA models, and predictive models of traffic participants and scenes. Your work will directly power Waabi World’s ability to model future evolution, synthesize realistic safety-critical scenarios, and provide rich generative priors for downstream planning, testing, and training.
You will…
Design, implement, and scale state-of-the-art generative and predictive world-modeling systems: 
Video generation and prediction
Latent diffusion / autoregressive / flow-matching models
Multimodal foundation models for driving scenes
LLM / VLM / VLA methods for scene understanding, reasoning, and control
Generative scenario modeling and controllable simulation
Model distillation
Collaborate closely with Research Scientists to translate cutting-edge model prototypes into robust, large-scale, distributed training and inference pipelines.
Optimize model training and inference for efficiency, speed, and reliability on large-scale datasets.
Build large scale data pipelines to build high quality datasets for training
Ensure the quality, stability, and maintainability of the world model codebase and infrastructure.
Stay on top of emerging advances in generative AI, distributed systems, and efficient model deployment in robotics.
 
Qualifications:
Strong software engineering and implementation: You have very strong Python & PyTorch (or JAX) skills; strong software-engineering fundamentals, and extensive experience with distributed training and large-scale model deployment.
Demonstrated technical impact: You have a Master's degree in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience in model development and scaling.
Expert domain knowledge: You have built and deployed generative or predictive models of the physical world, focusing on scale, efficiency, and robustness for real-world applications.
Team player: You have worked in a close-knit team of researchers and engineers and have strong communication to deliver successful projects in a fast-paced environment. 
 
Bonus:
Experience with infrastructure and tooling for large-scale ML training (e.g., cloud platforms, Kubeflow, Ray).
Experience with efficient model serving and deployment (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT).
Publications or research at top ML/CV/Robotics conference (e.g., CVPR, ECCV, NeurIPS)

 We are looking for a Senior Data Quality Engineer to build and operate the testing and validation capabilities that ensure data delivered through our enterprise data platform is accurate, complete, consistent, and fit for business use.
 Our environment includes Snowflake, AWS Aurora/RDS, Amazon MWAA/Apache Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, DataHub, Grafana, and CloudWatch .
 This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on end-to-end data pipeline testing, automated validation, regression testing, test-data management, and business-rule verification .
 A major part of the role is partnering with Product, Research, Advisory, Economics, Data Engineering, and other business subject-matter experts to translate business definitions, methodologies, and expected outcomes into measurable and repeatable tests.
 Data Engineers remain responsible for testing the pipelines and transformations they build. The Senior Data Quality Engineer provides reusable testing frameworks, curated test data, broader regression coverage, and independent validation for critical or higher-risk changes .
 This position will be located in Toronto, Ontario and is in office Monday through Friday. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Data Pipeline & Regression Testing 
 Design and execute testing strategies for ETL/ELT pipelines, transformations, integrations, and published data products.
 Validate data end to end, from source ingestion through transformation and final output.
 Perform source-to-target reconciliation to validate completeness, accuracy, mappings, calculations, aggregations, joins, filters, and business rules.
 Build regression coverage to detect unintended changes caused by pipeline, schema, transformation, or business-rule updates.
 Test large datasets using appropriate sampling, aggregate reconciliation, full-population comparisons, and targeted edge cases.
 Validate nulls, duplicates, referential integrity, incremental processing, historical behavior, distributions, and other material data conditions.
 Business-Driven Test Design 
 Work with business and domain experts to understand how critical data is expected to behave.
 Translate agreed business definitions, methodologies, calculations, and acceptance criteria into executable test scenarios.
 Identify business-critical attributes, expected outcomes, edge cases, and quality thresholds.
 Validate whether outputs conform to agreed business expectations, not simply whether pipelines execute successfully.
 Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and release-validation evidence.
 Test Data Management 
 Create and maintain curated test datasets and expected results representing common scenarios, edge cases, historical conditions, and known failure modes.
 Work with business SMEs and Data Engineers to identify representative records and expected outcomes.
 Use synthetic, masked, controlled, or approved production-derived data as appropriate to maintain safe test-data practices.
 Maintain reusable baseline datasets as source data, schemas, methodologies, and business rules evolve.
 Automation & Quality Frameworks 
 Develop reusable automated validation frameworks using SQL, Python, dbt, and other appropriate technologies .
 Automate checks for freshness, volume, completeness, uniqueness, validity, referential integrity, business rules, reconciliation, distribution, and drift.
 Build standardized testing patterns reusable across data products and pipelines.
 Partner with Data Platform Engineering to integrate quality checks into CI/CD, dbt, Airflow/MWAA, and release workflows .
 Enable critical validation failures to prevent downstream execution or publication where agreed quality thresholds are not met.
 Release Validation & Monitoring 
 Maintain risk-based regression suites for critical data products and pipelines.
 Independently validate material or higher-risk data releases before production publication.
 Compare candidate outputs against approved baselines or production results to identify unexpected differences.
 Provide objective quality evidence, identified risks, and release-readiness recommendations; business and product owners retain responsibility for business acceptance and publication decisions.
 Perform post-release validation for critical changes.
 Establish ongoing monitoring for key data-quality indicators and partner with Data Platform Engineering to surface actionable alerts through Grafana, CloudWatch, DataHub, or related capabilities.
 Investigate quality failures with Data Engineers and convert recurring defects into automated regression tests or preventative controls.
 Quality Standards & Enablement 
 Establish reusable data-testing standards, methodologies, templates, and best practices.
 Define expectations for test planning, evidence, defect documentation, and risk-based validation.
 Help Data Engineers apply appropriate project-level testing while providing independent validation where additional assurance is warranted.
 Mentor engineering teams on reconciliation, test-data design, regression testing, and data-quality engineering practices.
 Continuously improve test coverage and automation based on business impact and risk.
 Basic Qualifications: 
 6+ years of experience in Data Quality Engineering, Data Testing, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, including significant experience testing production data systems.
 Strong hands-on experience with ETL/ELT and end-to-end data pipeline testing .
 Strong experience with source-to-target reconciliation, regression testing, and large-dataset validation .
 Advanced SQL skills for data analysis, reconciliation, comparison, and validation.
 Strong scripting or test-automation skills, preferably Python .
 Experience designing automated data-testing or data-quality frameworks.
 Experience creating test cases, expected results, and curated test datasets for complex data scenarios.
 Experience validating data in modern cloud data platforms ; Snowflake experience is preferred.
 Experience testing pipelines built with technologies such as dbt, Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, or comparable ETL/ELT frameworks .
 Strong understanding of data-quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, validity, freshness, referential integrity, and distribution.
 Experience with defect analysis, release validation, and root-cause investigation.

 Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain quality findings and risks to both technical and business audiences.

 dbt testing and custom tests
 Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow
 AWS Glue and S3
 DataHub or similar metadata/catalog platforms
 Data profiling, anomaly detection, and statistical or distribution-based validation
 Data-quality scorecards and quality KPIs
 CI/CD integration for automated data testing

 Critical data sets have documented, repeatable, and risk-appropriate test coverage.
 Business definitions and expected outcomes are translated into measurable tests.

This approach helps community members access both preventive care and care when they are ill.

 The Case Manager, Welcoming Streets is responsible for the provision of individualized case management using the Housing First Model and outreach principles. The successful candidate will contribute to Durham Region’s Street Outreach Strategy.

Copywriter & Creative Strategist 
 Write the video ads that bring every new client into Limitless. 
 Location: Remote, United states, Canada, UK
 Team: Limitless Agency, Marketing & Creative
 Employment Type: Paid trial projects, then full-time
 Pay: $5,500 USD/month to start; $7,000 USD/month at full scope
 Primary Focus: All B2B and organic copy: ads, concepts, email, and content
 Also Owns: Quality on our AI-written student copy
 Reports To: Limitless founders
 About Limitless Agency 
 Limitless Agency is a coaching and build program for digital marketing agency owners. Our students run their own agencies, usually doing $40,000 to $100,000 a month. They come to us stuck: lead flow is inconsistent, they are the bottleneck in their own business, and what they have built is not sellable.
 We fix that over a 16-week engagement. Together with our students, we rebuild their acquisition system: ads, funnels, pipelines, automations, copy, and sales scripts. The program includes weekly live implementation calls, a private Slack with the founders, and quarterly workshops in Tampa.
 Both founders have built and scaled agencies of their own, and one of them sold. We have installed these systems in more than 250 agencies, and 50 of those have passed $100,000 a month.
 The Opportunity 
 Paid ads are the entire front end of this business. Every new client comes from a Meta ad, and right now the founders write every one of them. That is the constraint this role exists to solve.
 Put simply: if it is copy in our B2B marketing or our organic content, it runs through this seat.
 What You'll Do 
 Write our paid ad scripts. Deliver at least three new Meta video ad scripts every week, written alongside the founders. Some are filmed in-house; the rest go out to UGC creators. We want more creative in market, and we want it to be good.
 Bring new concepts. Great scripts on tired angles still lose. You will constantly look for what is working in organic feeds, other people's ads, and adjacent markets, then bring us new concepts and formats for delivering our message, not just better scripts for the ones we already run.
 Write organic and YouTube content. Create short-form scripts and posts for the founders' personal brands, plus long-form YouTube scripts and YouTube ads.
 Write email. Produce nurture sequences, broadcasts, and campaign emails for our list.
 Own student copy quality. Our students receive done-for-you ad copy from an AI copywriter we built and trained on scripts that have already produced results. You will review and fine-tune that copy before it reaches students, and keep improving the system so it needs less fine-tuning every month.
 Coach students live. Once a week, you will lead a live copywriting call where students bring their copy and you coach them through making it better.
 Paid ads, organic content, and new concepts are why this seat exists. Student copy quality is a real part of the job, but it is the smaller part.
 Video Scripts Are the Core 
 Video ads are what move the needle in this market, for us and for our students. Static and image ads have their place, but scripts produce the results. That is where most of your time goes, and it is what your work is judged on.
 Writing for spoken video is its own skill. A script that reads well on the page but sounds wrong out loud is a failed script. It has to sound like a real person talking, in the voice of whoever is on camera, with a hook that earns the next three seconds and a structure that holds attention through to the CTA.
 You also bring the creative direction: scene direction, on-screen text, props, formats, and cuts. The person filming needs to know how to shoot the script, not just read it.
 The Leverage Is Already Built 
 Three scripts a week is the floor, not the ceiling, and nobody here grinds that out by hand. You will have access to:
 A library of proven scripts that have already produced results
 Recorded sales calls
 A stack of AI tools and autonomous agents wired into our systems that pull buyer language from sales calls, surface the objections prospects actually raise, and deliver research that would otherwise take days
 We need someone who uses that leverage and still ships work that is genuinely good.
 How We Work 
 Turnaround is measured in days, not weeks. We rarely set deadlines; we pay attention to how fast "right" happens.
 You stay responsive throughout the working day.
 You take feedback quickly and without ego. Copy gets changed, and some gets killed. That is normal here, and it is not personal.
 You learn markets fast. Our buyer is the agency owner, but the student copy you review spans HVAC, gyms, med spas, roofers, law firms, and more. You need to know when it sounds wrong.
 You use AI as leverage, not as a ghostwriter. We expect you to lean on it heavily, but we can tell the difference between a writer using AI as a tool and AI using a writer as a delivery mechanism, and so can our buyers. Part of the job is making our AI copywriter better, not just cleaning up after it.
 Where This Role Goes 
 You start on our paid ad scripts, new concepts, and student copy quality, with organic and YouTube in the mix from the first weeks. As your ads prove out, you take more of the founders' content off their plate.
 There is no fixed waiting period. How fast this happens depends on the quality of your work. If your work is strong early, this moves early.
 Compensation 
 $5,500 USD per month to start, full-time, once you complete the paid trial.
 $7,000 USD per month at full scope: the weekly ad slate, new concepts, organic, and YouTube running without founder rewrites, with student copy quality holding.
 The step up is not based on a subjective review. The targets are written into your offer letter before you sign, so you know exactly what moves you to full scope.
 What Success Looks Like 
 Three or more new ad scripts every week, delivered without anyone chasing you
 The founders filming your scripts instead of rewriting them
 Winning ads in our account that started as your scripts, and at least some that started as your concepts
 Student copy that goes out right the first time, and an AI copywriter that needs less fine-tuning in month six than it did in month one
 Longer term, full ownership of our paid creative
 The Bar 
 High expectations on volume, speed, and quality, all at the same time. This seat writes the ads that fund the business.
 If you want time to polish every line before anyone sees it, this is not the role. If you want your work in market within days and a scoreboard that tells you whether you were right, it is.
 What We're Looking For 
 Based in EE UU, Canada or the UK
 A direct response writer who thinks in awareness levels, mechanisms, and offers
 Experience writing spoken video ad scripts for cold paid traffic, with firsthand knowledge of how they performed
 The ability to provide creative direction for video, including scene direction, on-screen text, props, formats, and cuts
 Speed backed by a system: you are fast because you have built something that makes you fast
 Strong, defensible opinions about what stops the scroll
 Heavy content consumption and a sharp eye for why things work, including the ability to spot a format taking off on organic and translate it into an ad
 The ability to explain your thinking live to agency owners who have never written a hook
 Comfort using AI tools heavily as leverage while still producing genuinely strong original work
 The ability to learn new markets quickly and recognize when copy sounds wrong across industries
 Responsiveness throughout the working day and the ability to take feedback quickly and without ego
 Portfolio required: include at least one spoken video ad script and tell us what it achieved
 Nice to Have 
 YouTube or short-form organic scripts to share
 A concept you originated, along with the results it produced
 Fully remote role for candidates based in North America
 Clear compensation path: $5,500 USD/month to start, rising to $7,000 USD/month at full scope, with the targets written into your offer letter before you sign
 Paid trial projects: every trial project is paid, and you never write for us for free
 Direct work with the founders, both of whom have built and scaled agencies, one through to a sale
 Built-in leverage: a library of proven scripts, recorded sales calls, and AI tools and autonomous agents integrated into our systems
 Growth based on performance: no fixed waiting period to take on more of the founders' content, with a long-term path to owning our paid creative
 Fast feedback loop: your work goes into market within days, with real results to show what's working

 What is The Role 
 We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to guide the vision, strategy, and execution for Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) within Elastic Security. Attackers not only break in - they log in. Identity is now a major target for attacks. These attacks can happen in on-premises setups, cloud environments, or with self-directed agents. Detecting and responding to identity-based attacks is essential for any modern Security Operations Center (SOC).
 In this high-impact role, you will define how Elastic detects, investigates, and responds to identity-based threats, building on our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation to deliver a credible, differentiated ITDR function. You will also own the roadmap for securing non-human and AI agent identities within Elastic Security, one of the fastest-growing and least-governed attack surfaces in the enterprise. You will work at the intersection of identity, detection engineering, and AI, partnering with threat researchers, data scientists, and engineers, and evangelizing our approach to a global community of security practitioners.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a credible ITDR function within Elastic Security, evolving our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation from behavioral analytics into an identity-defense outcome.
 Manage the plan for non-human and AI agent identities in Elastic Security. This involves modeling service accounts, workloads, secrets, and self-directed agents as important identities. Each identity will have its own behavior standards, ownership, and lifecycle. You will also establish how to detect identities that operate continuously and at machine scale.
 Work with threat research and detection engineering. Focus on identity-specific threats. These threats include credential access, privilege escalation, and identity-based lateral movement. They also involve the abuse of identity providers and tokens. Ensure that these threats relate to real-world adversary tactics.
 Drive the response and containment strategy. This is the 'R' in ITDR. Turn detections into action. Use identity-system integrations and automated responses. Make sure there is human oversight for important actions.
 Work closely with our enterprise customers. Collaborate with security operations teams, sales, and solution architects. Your goal is to understand the requirements for identity attacks. You will also discuss priorities and clarify product needs.
 Work with the design team to develop investigation and response experiences. These experiences will emphasize identity in the analyst workflow. Integrate identity signals with endpoint, cloud, and network data in the SIEM and XDR functions of our security operations platform.
 Gain deep knowledge of the identity-security market. Know its major trends and the changing threat landscape. Use this information to develop a unique strategy and engage with analysts.
 Be the product expert and evangelize Elastic's identity capabilities through content such as blog posts, talks, and open community interaction.
 What You Bring 
 Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or solution delivery for security products such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, identity security, or detection and response. A consistent record of leading sophisticated, data-intensive products from inception through launch and iterative growth.
 Identity Security Depth: A solid knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and the identity fabric. This includes Active Directory, cloud identity providers, SSO, OAuth, and privileged access. It also involves knowing how identity threats can occur in both on-premises and cloud environments. Knowledge of ITDR as a discipline and with entity behavioral analytics (UEBA).
 You need to be fluent in non-human identities. This includes service accounts, workloads, secrets, and AI agents. You should also understand why traditional human-identity rules don't apply to identities that act independently and continuously.
 AI and ML Fluency: Deep technical comprehension of the AI/ML landscape, including behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, LLMs, and agentic systems. You are comfortable working closely with data scientists and engineers, and you treat AI agents both as a subject to be secured and as a tool that consumes identity context.
 Bias to action: You are able to advance fast and quickly learn from experiments and tests. You utilize AI tools to help accelerate your processes and bring clarity to your decisions.
 Management and Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment. You operate with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.
 Communication Excellence: Outstanding spoken and written communication skills and practices. You can distill complex detection engineering and identity concepts into compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.
 Customer Obsession: An interest for industry trends and a commitment to solving real-world customer problems. You are an advocate for the security analyst and detection engineer, and you are focused on building products that help defenders stay ahead of identity-based threats.

Location: Canada – Remote 
 Department: Finance 
 Position: Oracle Cloud Developer 
 The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners to help them grow.
 Meet Nuvei. Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.
 At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We are dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!
 Your Mission
 Nuvei is looking for an Oracle Cloud Developer to join the UFS Reimagined program within the Finance organization. The program is delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and EPM across the Nuvei finance landscape in two waves, alongside a systems integrator and a number of specialist 3rd party partners for solutions implemented in parallel. This role sits on the Nuvei side of that program and builds, tests, and supports the Oracle technical objects the finance ecosystem runs on.
 The person in this role is hands-on. They will review and build integrations in Oracle Integration Cloud, develop reports, extracts, and extensions, prepare test data and execute the technical test cycles, investigate defects alongside the systems integrator and the peripheral system teams, and produce the documentation and runbooks that the support model depends on. Where an object needs to be built, proven, and handed over, this person does it.
 The role reports to the Director, Oracle Solutions, works day to day with the Oracle Cloud Technical Architect, and collaborates closely with functional business process leads, the systems integrator's technical team, Nuvei's information security and enterprise architecture teams, and the incoming application managed support partner. The role continues beyond go-live as part of the in-house technical capability retained within Nuvei.
 This role will suit someone with five or more years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud technical experience who has been through at least one full implementation lifecycle, from requirements through cutover and hypercare, and who is comfortable owning technical objects in a program with fixed phase gates.
 Responsibilities
 The role covers four areas. The balance of work shifts across the program, moving from specification review and build, through the test cycles and cutover at each wave, into support, defect resolution, and documentation once the ecosystem is live.
 Integration Build and Oracle Integration Cloud
 Review interface specifications, payloads, APIs, file formats, mappings, transformations, validations, and orchestration steps produced by the systems integrator, and mark up what does not hold.
 Configure or develop the approved Oracle Integration Cloud components, reusable routines, validation rules, error messages, and exception-handling logic assigned to Nuvei.
 Work fluently with Oracle Fusion Cloud integration surfaces, including REST and SOAP web services, the ERP Integration Service, file-based data import, and business events.
 Apply the agreed coding, naming, version control, security, logging, and deployment standards to every integration component, and correct anything that does not comply.
 Support the Oracle Integration Cloud posting path from the business rules platform on Azure and Snowflake into the Oracle general ledger, including file-based data import and reconciliation evidence.
 Confirm build estimates, technical dependencies, reusable components, and development sequencing with the architect before construction starts.
 Reporting, Extensions, and Fusion Technical Build
 Develop and support reporting and extract objects using BI Publisher and OTBI, including the reports and extracts that feed downstream systems and the finance close.
 Build Fusion Cloud extensions and personalizations where a functional configuration cannot meet the requirement, and keep them upgrade-safe through the quarterly update cycle.
 Configure and maintain the technical elements of Fusion security, including role design support, data access sets, and segregation of duties.
 Implement integration security correctly, including OAuth and certificate-based authentication, service accounts, key and wallet management, and credential handling.
 Maintain the technical design documentation for every object built or amended, at a standard that survives handover to the support partner.
 Testing, Deployment, and Defect Resolution
 Prepare representative test data and scripts covering normal processing, negative paths, duplicate transactions, retries, recovery, security, volume, and reconciliation scenarios.
 Execute unit, system integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and recovery testing across Oracle Fusion Cloud and each connected peripheral system.
 Reconcile test results back to source and target records, evidence the agreed data-quality thresholds, and obtain acceptance from the relevant business data owners.
 Investigate defects with the systems integrator and the source-system teams, implement fixes, complete retesting, and close issues only when the supporting evidence is complete.
 Support production deployment and cutover, including load sequencing, smoke testing, initial monitoring, and the stabilization period that follows each wave.
 Move configuration and technical objects between environments, including Functional Setup Manager exports, integration artefacts, reports, and security definitions.
 Post Go-Live Support, Runbooks, and Knowledge Transition
 Produce and maintain code documentation, deployment instructions, operating procedures, troubleshooting guidance, and support runbooks for every object in the retained ecosystem.
 Take part in the knowledge transition from the systems integrator and support the onboarding of the application managed support partner.
 Provide the in-house technical support that sits alongside the partner-delivered service, covering the integration and infrastructure scope retained by Nuvei.
 Build and maintain the technical monitoring, alerting, error queues, and replay mechanisms that the proactive operations monitoring model relies on.
 Be actively available through hypercare, month-end close, and year-end, when support demand and business impact are both at their highest.

Job Title: AI Associate Principal - Radioconjugate Discovery 
 Location: Hamilton, Ontario 
 Onsite 5 days/week 
 Description: 
 Fusion Pharmaceuticals, part of the AstraZeneca Group, is redefining precision oncology with next‑generation radioconjugates that deliver powerful alpha‑emitting payloads directly to tumors. Our pipeline spans multiple first‑in‑class programs—backed by a GMP‑compliant, brand new radiopharmaceutical facility in Hamilton, we’re turning groundbreaking science into real‑world impact for patients. Join us at the forefront of radiopharma innovation and be part of turning breakthrough science into meaningful outcomes for patients—come build what’s next with us!
 The Role: 
 The AI Associate Principal - Radioconjugate Discovery will be accountable for designing, building, deploying, and maintaining software and AI-enabled solutions that accelerate Radioconjugate (RC) Discovery. The AI Associate Principal combines software engineering, data engineering, automation, and applied AI to transform complex scientific workflows into scalable, reliable, and user-friendly tools.
 This is a hands-on builder role. You will work directly with RC Discovery scientists to find opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and use AI-assisted coding to design, build, test, document, deploy, and maintain production-quality analytical tools. You are expected to write and review code, interrogate data, troubleshoot workflows, and iterate with end users, not solely advise, commission work, or provide strategic oversight.
 As an embedded technical leader, you will help shape the RC Discovery AI and data science strategy, establish fit-for-purpose engineering practices, mentor colleagues, and deliver measurable value through improved consistency, efficiency, reproducibility, traceability, and scientific decision-making. You will work closely with Data & AI colleagues, data and software engineers, computational scientists, and scientific partners across imaging, DMPK, safety, translational research, and other relevant collaborators. It will also involve collaboration with cloud, cybersecurity, IT operations, legal, privacy, quality, and compliance teams to ensure that solutions are secure, compliant, maintainable, and fit for purpose.
 Responsibilities: 
 Hands-on AI-assisted software development: Personally design, write, review, test, debug, deploy, and maintain code using modern AI-assisted development approaches. Apply sound software engineering judgment to validate generated code, manage dependencies, protect data integrity, and ensure solutions are scientifically and technically fit for purpose.
 Workflow discovery and prioritization: Partner directly with RC Discovery scientists to observe and understand current workflows. Identify recurring difficulties and sources of variability. Prioritize use cases based on scientific value, feasibility, adoption potential, and operational impact.
 End-to-end solution delivery: Lead the full lifecycle from problem definition and data exploration through prototyping, model or algorithm development, validation, implementation, user acceptance, release, documentation, training, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
 RC Discovery data and analytics: Develop solutions that integrate, analyze, and visualize structured and unstructured discovery data. Potential applications include biodistribution, imaging, radiochemistry, in vitro and in vivo assay data, immunohistochemistry (IHC), PK/PD and dosimetry-related analyses, automated quality control, scientific reporting, and decision-support workflows.
 Applied AI and intelligent automation: Leverage AI, machine learning, large language models, statistical methods, and other computational approaches when they provide clear value. Prioritize practical, maintainable, and user-adopted solutions over methodological novelty.
 Software engineering and platform development: Design and maintain robust software applications, APIs, data pipelines, automation frameworks, dashboards, and scientific platforms that support RC Discovery workflows. Apply modern engineering practices to ensure reliability, maintainability, scalability, and long-term supportability.
 Consistency and reproducibility: Create standardized and traceable analytical pipelines that reduce manual handling, minimize avoidable errors, improve reproducibility, and promote consistent interpretation and reporting across RC Discovery programs.
 Data and model quality: Define fit-for-purpose validation approaches, data-quality checks, test cases, acceptance criteria, version control, and performance monitoring. Clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, uncertainty, and appropriate use of outputs.
 Architecture, security, and compliance: Design solutions with consideration for scalability, maintainability, access controls, information security, data privacy, intellectual property protection, and applicable regulatory and AstraZeneca AI-governance requirements.
 Technical leadership: Advise on guidelines and innovative methods, set pragmatic technical standards, make build-versus-buy recommendations, and guide project decisions while remaining directly involved in implementation.
 Collaboration and translation: Translate scientific and business needs into clear technical requirements and convert complex data and model outputs into actionable insights for scientific and non-technical audiences.
 Capability building: Mentor and coach colleagues in data literacy, responsible AI use, reproducible analytics, AI-assisted coding, and effective adoption of new tools. Develop clear user documentation and training materials.
 External awareness and innovation: Maintain current knowledge of relevant AI, data science, computational biology, and scientific software trends. Evaluate emerging methods and external collaborations for practical application within RC Discovery.
 Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree, or equivalent extensive experience, in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, computational science, bioinformatics, cheminformatics, or a related quantitative field.
 Strong hands-on programming capability, particularly in Python and relevant scientific or data libraries, with the ability to rapidly learn and apply additional languages or platforms as needed.
 Experience with software-engineering practices including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, reproducible environments, issue tracking, and release management.
 Demonstrated experience designing, developing, validating, deploying, and supporting AI, machine-learning, advanced analytics, or data-science solutions with real-world scientific or business impact.
 Demonstrated use of AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development while independently verifying code correctness, scientific validity, security, maintainability, and performance.
 Experience integrating and analyzing large, complex, heterogeneous datasets and building robust data pipelines, analytical applications, or decision-support tools.
 Ability to translate ambiguous scientific problems into testable requirements, prototypes, validated solutions, and sustainable user workflows.
 Strong analytical judgment, attention to data quality, and ability to communicate assumptions, limitations, uncertainty, and validation evidence.
 Excellent collaboration, consulting, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing technical and non-technical collaborators.
 Experience leading technical projects, mentoring colleagues, and delivering through multi-functional collaboration while remaining a hands-on individual contributor.
 Desirable: 
 Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life-science, healthcare, or drug-discovery environments.
 Understanding of radioconjugate or radiopharmaceutical discovery workflows, including one or more of biodistribution, molecular imaging, radiochemistry, in vitro pharmacology, in vivo studies, PK/PD, dosimetry, or translational data integration.
 Experience with modern AI and data-science frameworks and services, for example PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Spark, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, computer vision, or workflow orchestration tools.
 Experience building user-facing scientific applications, dashboards, APIs, automated reports, or self-service analytical tools.
 Experience with cloud or high-performance computing environments and modern data platforms, preferably within an enterprise setting.
 Knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, cybersecurity, validation, and regulated or quality-managed environments.
 Evidence of innovation through novel computational methods, patents, publications, conference contributions, open-source work, or impactful internal capabilities.

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





Why we're looking for you

 

We’re building a highly impactful, data & AI-first Product Analytics function at Owner.com http://Owner.com. As a Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the product roadmap through close collaboration with Product Managers to establish opportunity impact sizing, product effectiveness tracking, and direct product strategy & tactical contributions. 

Your work will shift to wherever the highest impact lies - whether that's deep root-cause analysis on product opportunity areas, sizing the expected impact of new features to shape engineering priorities, designing & providing visibility to product health metrics, or directly contributing to the development of analytics and AI-powered product features. The best candidates will not simply provide insights to the EPD (Engineering & Product) org, but be a strategic and operational driver, identifying gaps/opportunities, recommending product roadmap improvements, and creating overall meaningful business impact through direct influence on the product.

 

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

 

You should apply if you ...

 

 - Have felt torn about whether to pursue a business vs pure technical/analytical career path (at Owner, we believe these must merge)

 - Identify inefficiencies in everyday life - and see them as exciting opportunities.

 - Aren't satisfied with understanding things at a surface level, and get satisfaction from understanding the root cause (the WHY)

 - When solving problems, you enjoy diving deeply in them to understand root causes and become a "subject matter expert”, but know when to stop “overbuilding”

 - Aren't afraid of and enjoy picking up new skills and tools to problem-solve

 - Enjoy tinkering and testing (or building) applications for AI tools like Claude Code, Codex

 - Want to build solutions for lasting processes and systems. Love a good data-driven decision-making process (but also understand when this is possible and when it isn't)

 - Have a proven track record of collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
   
   

The impact you'll have



 - Influence Product Planning Roadmap: Influence product planning through informative impact sizing, enabling more strategic decision-making for Owner.

 - Uncover Product Gaps, and Recommend/Action Resolutions: Analyze the root cause for product success metric gaps and issues, and recommend immediate resolution pathways, or action them yourself.

 - Own Your Product Pod’s Analytics: Improve the analytics and engagement strategy for your product pod(s). This isn't just an insights role - you'll design and ship data products and automated AI workflows that enable teams to act on data without waiting for analysis.

 - Tackle emerging priorities: Lead or contribute to ad hoc projects as business needs arise; this role flexes with what matters most.

 - Ultimately, help grow our customers’ sales and improve their experience: Across all product pods, the mission is uniform: improve our customer’s experience and help customers grow their sales with Owner.com http://Owner.com.



Who you’ll work with



 - Reporting Structure: This role reports directly to Mark Rogal, Manager, Product Analytics & Applied AI

 - Team Collaboration: You will be embedded within up to two product squads (preferably one), working closely with Product Managers, designers, and developers within their regular sprint cadence.

 - Technical Collaboration: You will collaborate with Analytics Engineers on all technical aspects, including data modeling, data quality, and the use of tools like DBT and Snowflake.

 - Executive Visibility: The work in this role directly drives product strategy, which means regular exposure to senior and executive leadership.



What we're looking for



 - 4+ years in analytics, strategy, or ops - whether that's management consulting, startup analytics, or a hybrid path that's hard to label

 - Extremely strong quantitative skills, with additional technical background or education strongly preferred. SQL/Python/Claude Code/Codex and product analytics experience is a strong plus

 - You've built things - dashboards, tools, processes - not just delivered decks

 - You dig into root causes until you actually understand the problem, not just the symptoms

 - Comfortable with ambiguity; you don't need a playbook to figure out what to work on next

 - Experience with SaaS, marketplaces, or high-growth startups preferred

 - Restaurant industry experience is a plus
   
   
   

Compensation and benefits

 - The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 USD depending on such factors such as level, experience and location. The offer will also include a generous pre-IPO equity package

 - Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote first, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!



What our interview process looks like



Step 1: Recruiter Phone Screen

Begin with a conversation with a recruiter to evaluate your background, better understand what you’re looking for in your next opportunity, and answer any early questions you may have about the role or company.

 

Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview

Participate in a 45-minute video interview with the hiring manager. This conversation will go deeper into your experience, approach to work, and views on problem-solving and collaboration.

 

Step 3: Technical Case Study (Pass/Fail)

Receive a technical case study to complete independently. You will have seven days to submit your assignment. The team will review your submission and provide detailed feedback on whether you have passed or not passed this stage.

 

Step 4: Full Round / Case Study Presentation

If you pass the technical case study, you'll move forward to a 60-minute presentation round with several members of the Business Operations team. You'll walk the team through your approach, thought process, and recommendations, and answer live follow-up questions.

 

Step 5: Final / Executive Interviews

The final stage consists of one to two executive interviews with C-suite leadership team members. These 30-minute conversations focus on overall alignment, communication, strategic thinking, and long-term fit with the business.





Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.



We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.
